newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (5 of 7).
newsitem.headline: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (5 of 7).

text.p: (This is an unofficial translation of Romania's government Decree no.31/16.06.1997 on foreign investment. The unofficial translation was provided by Price Waterhouse Romania.
For any querries please contact Price Waterhouse at telephone +40-1 311-2455, fax +40-1 312-3334.)
Attraction, Promotion and registration of Foreign Invesments
Art.16 The activity to attract and promote foreign investments in Romania is conducted by the Romanian Development Agency, and as the case may be, the State Ownership Fund.

Art.17 (1) The registration of foreign investments in Romania, made in any of the forms provided by Article 1, paragraph (2) herein, shall be made in compliance with Law no. 31 of 1990 and Law no.26 of 1990, regarding the Commerce Register.

(2) The foreign investments made in the form of securities companies, financial investment companies, mutual funds, and banking or insurance/ reinsurance companies shall be registered only upon the approval of the National Securities Commission, National Bank of Romania and/or the Ministry of Finance, as the case may be.

Art.18 (1) The foreign investors shall enjoy specialised assistance and other services rendered by the Romanian Development Agency, in order to provide them with reliable information regarding business opportunities in Romania and ensure the expeditious completion of the legal formalities for the registration of the investment, upon the request of such investors and against a lump fee established by the Ministry of Finance.

(2) The income obtained from the specialised assistance activities rendered by the Romanian Development Agency to foreign investors, including 50 percent of the amounts collected for the issuance of investor Certificates, may be used by this institution as a source of financing its current activities, including the remuneration of its personnel.

(3) The ministries and other public institutions or the central and local administration authorities shall cooperate with the Romanian Development Agency and shall answer to its requests which are aimed at ensuring specialised assistance to foreign investors, within 15 days from the receipt of such request.

Art.19 (1) By Government decision, a working team shall be formed and shall be responsible for the expeditious resolution of the specific issues arising throughout the establishment of the companies with the foreign capital contribution, or during the development of the activity of such company.
(2) The technical secretariate of the working team group mentioned above shall be provided by the personnel of the Romanian Development Agency.
